exact_mechanism: Online Adaptive Anomaly Thresholding with Confidence Sequences (time-uniform empirical Bernstein bounds)
metrics: FPR, FNR, empirical coverage, detection delay
poisoning_threat_model: Assumes uncontaminated reference stream; vulnerable to high-rate score poisoning
constraints_guarantees: Time-uniform PAC guarantee: P(exists t: FPR_t > alpha) <= delta
exact_distinction_from_cgb: Sun et al. provide theoretical anytime-valid confidence bounds; CGB is heuristic/empirical gating combining cooldown, alert-rate cap, and winsorization.

exact_mechanism: Adaptive Anomaly Detection for IoT Concept Drift via drift-detection statistical testing and fine-tuning
poisoning_threat_model: Assumes drift is benign; vulnerable to adversarial poisoning during retraining
constraints_guarantees: No formal PAC guarantee; bounded adaptation budget
exact_distinction_from_cgb: ADTCD retrains model weights on detected drift; CGB freezes model weights completely and adapts only the decision threshold at runtime.

exact_mechanism: Concept Drift Detection, Interpretation, and Adaptation (divergence tracking + selective feature adaptation)
poisoning_threat_model: Detects feature shift but requires delayed labels for verification
exact_distinction_from_cgb: CDDIA requires feature-level attribution and model adaptation; CGB operates strictly at the score-to-decision boundary without delayed labels.

exact_mechanism: Online ensemble learning with dynamic weighting and incremental streaming updates
poisoning_threat_model: Susceptible to slow poisoning of ensemble component weights
constraints_guarantees: Empirical stability bounds on ensemble loss
exact_distinction_from_cgb: ASOC 2025 continuously updates ensemble model weights; CGB operates on a single lightweight frozen autoencoder, adjusting only the threshold.

exact_mechanism: Hybrid CNN-Transformer with energy-efficient sparse attention and adaptive edge pruning
poisoning_threat_model: Does not evaluate adversarial threshold poisoning
exact_distinction_from_cgb: Focuses on neural architecture design and edge energy optimization; does not address online threshold contamination or flood resilience.

exact_mechanism: Semi-supervised decision boundary adaptation guided by high-confidence pseudo-labels and operator feedback
poisoning_threat_model: Vulnerable to adversarial label poisoning if false negatives accepted as feedback
constraints_guarantees: Bounded boundary shift per operator verification epoch
exact_distinction_from_cgb: Requires operator feedback loop or pseudo-label confidence; CGB is fully autonomous, using alert rate and cooldown to gate updates.

exact_mechanism: Static 95th percentile MSE reconstruction thresholding on 2-layer LSTM autoencoder
poisoning_threat_model: Static threshold: blind to drift; vulnerable to threshold bypass
constraints_guarantees: No formal guarantees; proposed dynamic thresholding as future work
exact_distinction_from_cgb: Saeed uses a fixed 95th percentile threshold on private data; CGB directly answers Saeed's open call for dynamic thresholding on public CICIoT2023.

exact_mechanism: Heuristic score-level controller: eligibility gate g_t, alert-rate cap (W=50), incident freeze, clean cooldown (W=15), winsorization, per-step clipping
baselines: Fixed q95, Fixed q99, Raw EWMA, Excluded EWMA, Rolling Quantile
metrics: Precision, Recall, F1, FPR, latency, threshold trace
poisoning_threat_model: Explicitly modeled: resists sustained DDoS floods by freezing updates when g_t=0
constraints_guarantees: Heuristic operational bounds (|Delta tau| <= 0.005); no formal PAC guarantee
exact_distinction_from_cgb: Engineering synthesis of industrial control mechanisms (cooldown, winsorization, alert rate gating) to prevent threshold collapse without model retraining.
